rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for suffering or emotional pain, including grief.

example.english: That period of unemployment caused me a lot of grief.
example.traditional: 失業嗰段時間，令我承受咗好多痛苦。
example.jyutping: sat1 jip6 go2 dyun6 si4 gaan1 ling6 ngo5 sing4 sau6 zo2 hou2 do1 tung3 fu2

rows.note: Use this for especially intense sorrow, particularly after bereavement, rather than for general suffering.

example.english: He remained in deep grief after the death of his family member.
example.traditional: 家人離世後，他一直沉浸於悲痛之中。
example.jyutping: gaa1 jan4 lei4 sai3 hau6 taa1 jat1 zik6 cam4 zam3 jyu1 bei1 tung3 zi1 zung1

rows.note: Use this when “grief” means trouble or annoyance caused by a person or situation.

example.english: That customer gives me a lot of grief by changing the order all the time.
example.traditional: 嗰個客成日改單，真係畀我好多麻煩。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 haak3 seng4 jat6 goi2 daan1 zan1 hai6 bei2 ngo5 hou2 do1 maa4 faan4
